name: Mortem Metallum [Alpha]
desc:
Hit and slash, Run and Chase, fight in a bloody way. Nos militibus!

Check out social links.

Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/9642124/Mortem-Metallum-OFFICIAL#!/about

Exploiting = ban.

If you own any of the old gamepasses you wont need to buy them again because they work on this game aswell.

Controls:
E-Dash
Q-Kick (only does dmg to ragdolled opponents)
Ctrl-Shoulder camera (Shiftlock. For this to work you need to have the shiftlock setting on. You will see it when you press Esc ingame.)
